description:
Project Moon Ship Names

A custom namelist I threw together for my amusement that I thought others might enjoy. Featuring names taken from the Project Moon games: Lobotomy Corporation, Library of Ruina, and Limbus Company.

This mod may be freely added to or removed from saves.

Fully compatible with other mods.

Download Here

Names are tagged as Abnormality, EGO, and Mili for control when editing the faction name source files.

Mili names are snippets from the lyrics of the music.

By default they are just added into the Player Faction name pool with a weight of 1 each.

These lists contain nominal spoilers for all three games, however they are so divorced from context I don't think they would be too bad.

Let me know if anyone has suggestions for more names or other tweaks and I might add them later when I go back and add the two EGO that I just realized I forgot.

I am on the fence about the leading "The" in many of these names. How do we feel about that?

Credit, obviously to Project Moon and Mili for the names.
